title: IonQ Announces Partnership with QuantumCT to Expand Quantum Computing Access
summary: IonQ partners with QuantumCT to provide Connecticut researchers, universities, and enterprises with direct cloud access to trapped-ion quantum computers.
body_markdown:
*Agreement secures IonQ compute resources for Connecticut-based universities, researchers, and enterprises advancing quantum information science and technologies*


**COLLEGE PARK, Md. — Nov. 4, 2026 —** IonQ (NYSE: IONQ), the world's leading full-stack quantum platform and foundry, today announced a partnership with QuantumCT, Connecticut's statewide initiative to accelerate quantum innovation and economic development. QuantumCT will purchase access to IonQ's trapped-ion quantum computers on behalf of Connecticut-based, quantum-focused organizations.


Under the agreement, QuantumCT will make IonQ's cloud quantum computing resources available to its network of academic institutions, research laboratories, startups, and enterprises across the state. Participating organizations will use IonQ's systems to extend research in quantum information science and technologies. Areas of focus will span quantum algorithms, optimization, materials science, and workforce development. The contract includes access to more than 150 hours of cloud runtime on IonQ’s quantum computers and takes Connecticut's quantum community from exploration to application.


QuantumCT is anchored by the University of Connecticut and Yale University. It’s supported by a coalition of industry, government, and academic partners to position Connecticut as a national hub for quantum research, talent, and commercialization. Access to IonQ's commercial systems gives the state's researchers and businesses hands-on experience with frontier quantum hardware. That access enables the development of applications, skills, and companies that will define the quantum economy.


“Regional quantum ecosystems thrive when researchers and innovators have access to advanced quantum computers,” said Scott Millard, Chief Business Officer of IonQ. “By securing access to quantum computing resources, QuantumCT is giving Connecticut’s universities, startups, and enterprises the opportunity to build practical quantum capabilities today. We’re proud that IonQ’s systems will power that work and help strengthen Connecticut’s quantum community.”


“Expanding access to advanced quantum computing resources is an important step in helping Connecticut’s researchers, startups, and industry partners move from exploration to practical application. Our agreement with IonQ gives the QuantumCT ecosystem access to the trapped-ion platform, along with the technical support needed to put that capability to work. At the same time, QuantumCT intends to build a broader, modality-diverse computing environment, providing access to multiple quantum computing approaches so users can match the right technology to the right problem. This partnership is an important part of that strategy and of our goal to strengthen Connecticut’s position as a leading hub for quantum innovation,” said QuantumCT Interim CEO, Vivek Ramakrishnan.

**About IonQ**


[IonQ, Inc](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2F&esheet=54451094&newsitemid=20260316477473&lan=en-US&anchor=IonQ%2C+Inc&index=7&md5=0818ffbedc6dbad8c4d1611ac94c2a0f) . \[NYSE: IONQ\] is the world’s leading quantum platform and foundry - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the Superion, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems. Earlier systems have helped customers and partners including[Amazon Web Services, AstraZeneca, and NVIDIA](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.ionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-speeds-quantum-accelerated-drug-development-application-with&esheet=54568606&lan=en-US&anchor=Amazon+Web+Services%2C+AstraZeneca%2C+and+NVIDIA&index=2&md5=01bdaebe76912a4097387943d94d15d7) achieve a 20x performance increase over previous quantum solutions and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity,[setting a world record in quantum computing performance](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fionq.com%2Fnews%2Fionq-achieves-landmark-result-setting-new-world-record-in-quantum-computing&esheet=54568606&lan=en-US&anchor=setting+a+world+record+in+quantum+computing+performance&index=3&md5=cd2c9fd48587a4276bc37aaa73b82b5c) .


Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations across North America, Latin America, EMEA, and APAC. Our quantum computing services have been available through all major cloud providers since 2021, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before. Learn more at[IonQ.com](http://ionq.com/) .


**About QuantumCT**


QuantumCT is Connecticut's statewide initiative to accelerate quantum technology research, workforce development, and economic growth. Led by the University of Connecticut and Yale University in partnership with industry, government, and community stakeholders, QuantumCT connects the state's quantum ecosystem to advance quantum information science and position Connecticut as a national leader in the emerging quantum economy. Learn more at[QuantumCT.org](http://quantumct.org/) .
